ledger.note: 959: Hasanwayh ibn Husayn founds the Hasanwayhid emirate (infobox 959-1015); 'the deaths of two uncles in 960 and 961 let him gather fortresses around Qarmisin (Kermanshah)'.

region.text: Dinavar, Nahavand, Asadabad, Borujerd and Shahrizor

ledger.note: 979: the Jibal holdings. Hasanwayh 'died in 979 in his fortress of Sarmaj'; by Badr's time the family held 'Dinavar, Nahavand, Asadabad, Shapurkhast, Borujerd', several districts of Ahwaz, and 'Qarmisin, Hulwan, and Shahrizor at times' (undated; the page says Badr expelled Abu al-Fath ibn Annaz from Shahrizor).
1013: the Annazids recapture Shahrizor. 'In 1013, after Baha' al-Dawla's death, Abu al-Fath recaptured Shahrizor.' (Hostilities with Abu al-Fath ibn Annaz had resumed in 1006-1007.)

region.text: the Hasanwayhid lands in the Jibal

ledger.note: 1015: the Annazids replace the Hasanwayhids in the Jibal. Badr 'was killed in 1014 while fighting a minor group'; 'the Annazid rule in the Jibal replaced that of the Hasanwayhids'.
1015: the Hasanwayhid emirate ends (infobox disestablished 1015); the family kept the fortress of Sarmaj, where the last heir died in 1047.

wars.name: Hasanwayhid-Annazid war over Shahrizor
wars.outcome: Badr expelled Abu al-Fath ibn Annaz; hostilities resumed in 1006-1007 and in 1013 Abu al-Fath recaptured Shahrizor; the Annazids replaced the Hasanwayhids in the Jibal after Badr's death in 1014.

certainty.note: A Kurdish fortress emirate named by towns (Dinavar, Nahavand, Borujerd, Shahrizor); the page gives no frontiers and no dates for the holdings.

notes: Cliopatria has no Hasanwayhid row. Wikidata id not known; left null. Thin on dates: no gain is dated except the founding; 979 is bridging for the holdings. Not drawn: the districts of Ahwaz, Hamadan, Hulwan and Qarmisin 'at times'. The Buyid vassalage (autonomy granted in December 970 by Ibn al-'Amid's successor against tribute and tax rights; Badr served Fakhr al-Dawla, Mu'ayyad al-Dawla and Baha' al-Dawla; title Nasir al-Dawla from the caliph in 998) is Hasanwayhid vassalage for the Buyid dossier. Counterparts needing dossiers: annazids (990-1117, Hamadan/Dinawar/Shahrizor; not written), buyid-dynasty (me-08-c). The page does not mention the Kakuyids or Sinjar. Resolved names: Kermanshah, Borujerd, As-Sulaymaniyah; coordinates stand for Dinavar, Nahavand and Asadabad (gazetteer lacks them).
